name: PromptLayer
short: Prompt management, observability, and evaluation platform with prompt versioning, playgrounds, datasets, and eval cells for AI teams.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5 users, 2,500 requests/month, 1 workspace, 250 eval cell executions/month, 10 MB max per dataset; basic support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited playgrounds and workspaces, 150 MB max per dataset, pay-as-you-go overage at $0.003/txn.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: 25 users, 100k+ requests/month, 7.5k+ eval cell executions/month, 1 GB max per dataset, webhooks.
